modelRules.label: No duplicate Mark
modelRules.statement: In each listed category, no two elements share a value of the listed parameter.

modelRules.label: Revit warnings
modelRules.statement: The model has no more than 2200 Revit warnings.

modelRules.label: Identical instances in one place
modelRules.statement: No two identical instances sit in the same place.

modelRules.label: Duplicate grids
modelRules.statement: The model has one set of grids, with no duplicate grids.

modelRules.label: Duplicate levels
modelRules.statement: The model has one set of levels, with no duplicate levels.

modelRules.label: Elements on a level
modelRules.statement: At least 95% of the model elements are associated with a level.

modelRules.label: Worksets as listed
modelRules.statement: Every model uses the worksets listed.

modelRules.label: In-place families
modelRules.statement: The model has no more than 400 in-place families.

modelRules.label: Imported CAD
modelRules.statement: No CAD file is imported into the model; CAD files are linked.

modelRules.label: Elements with a real material
modelRules.statement: At least 70% of the model elements carry a real material; the names listed do not count as a material.

modelRules.label: Lighting Fixtures outside the MEP model
modelRules.statement: Elements of the listed category are modelled only in the listed discipline's model; other models show none.

modelRules.label: Project parameters never filled
modelRules.statement: Every project parameter has a value on at least one element.

modelRules.label: Elements far from the levels
modelRules.statement: No element sits more than 3000 mm below the lowest level or above the highest level.
